messages:
alex_choi: FYI customer DocuPal opened an escalation — p99 latency spiked ~3x right after we flipped their quant profile to int8 this morning.

mira_g: ugh, did they also change batch/window settings or was it just the profile toggle?

alex_choi: They only toggled to int8 via the console (customer-managed rollouts). No other config changes reported. Observed spike at ~09:12 UTC.

sam_irving: Any auth or retry storms around the same time? sometimes token refresh failures cause retries and tail latency.

alex_choi: Good point — they reported intermittent 401s for ~10m starting 09:10 but then billing alerts fired as well (payment callouts). Could be correlated.

jules_ml: I pulled the serving traces — the p95 is fine, p99 jumps on long KV cache misses and an extra kernel path used for quantized matmul (int8 pack path). Stack: runtime v2.4.1 -> quant-kernel v1.9.

ops-bot: Deploy finished: runtime/v2.4.1 → 2026-03-15T09:05:22Z.

mira_g: Can you paste a sample trace or log lines?

alex_choi: snippet:
```
[09:12:34.912] rpc_id=0x7f8a latency_ms=1340 model=redwood-13b-int8 kernel=matmul_int8_pack path=quant_pack.cu:482
[09:12:34.913] rpc_id=0x7f8a kv_cache_miss=true kv_fetch_ms=420
[09:12:34.914] auth=401 token_refresh=true retries=3
```

sam_irving: kv_cache_miss + int8 pack path = bad combo for tail latency. If kv cache miss forces larger sequence and kernel chooses slow int8 fallback it explains the spike. Also those 401 retries amplify load.

karen_support: Customer is asking for immediate mitigation — they want traffic stable now, quality can degrade.

jules_ml: Mitigation options: 1) Immediate: set per-deployment fallback to fp16 for 100% (fast rollback). 2) Short-term: enable fp16 fallback on p99 route (10% traffic) and disable int8 pack optimization. 3) Medium: rerun calibration with larger sample set, bump warmup and disable aggressive packing heuristics.

mira_g: Steps to rollback (I can run):
```
redwoodctl set-model --deployment docupal-prod --variant fp16 --traffic 100 --reason "emergency fallback int8 latency spike"
```

sam_irving: Also recommend throttling client retries during auth failures and temporarily exempting retry spikes from autoscaling triggers.

alex_choi: I'll do the rollback now and tell DocuPal. After rollback we'll collect a calibration artifact and reproduce locally.

ops-bot: Action logged: ticket#DP-4821 created, priority=P0.

mira_g: After rollback, run this repro harness against their request pattern:
```
python tests/repro_harness.py --model redwood-13b --quant int8 --seq-distribution sample.json --concurrency 8 --measure p99
```

jules_ml: If repro shows int8 path regression on cache misses, patch quickfix: avoid pack-path when seq_length > 1024 or when kv_cache_miss=true. I can prototype a guard.

karen_support: Customer confirmed decreased latency after we switched to fp16. They accepted a canary plan to reintroduce int8 with smaller traffic and extended calibration. :relieved:

alex_choi: Follow-ups: 1) Jira for calibration re-run and telemetry (JIRA-8721). 2) Runtime patch to toggle packing guard (ENG-PR-549). 3) Add a circuit-breaker to suppress client retries on 401s and surface a clear error to customers.

sam_irving: I'll own the retry circuit-breaker change.

jules_ml: I'll start the calibration job; need access to their sample prompts and longer warmup.

mira_g: Thanks everyone — moving to postmortem once we have repro results.

ops-bot: Reminder: please attach all artifacts to ticket#DP-4821 (logs, calibration reports, repro results).
